name: Claire Bennett

immutable.face: oval face, high cheekbones, strong dark straight eyebrows, expressive eyes, straight slim nose, full lips
immutable.hair: dark brown all the way to the ends (never copper or auburn), long soft waves, curtain bangs, worn loose in scenes
immutable.hair_seven_years_ago: dark brown, long, wavy, NO bangs
immutable.watch: white dial, black strap, LEFT wrist
immutable.necklace: ONE small dark-red pendant on a thin gold chain
immutable.lipstick: wine red (none at home in the morning)

generator_errors: face mixed with Olivia when both in the same chat

looks.L6: black fine turtleneck, taupe pleated trousers, black belt with gold buckle, black ankle boots (EP02, V54)
looks.L7: dark-red silk blouse with soft high neck, black tailored trousers, black belt, black block-heel boots, long charcoal wool coat with inner pocket (EP03, V75)

voice.register: controlled, dry, precise; irony without raising the voice

camera: static, symmetrical; slightly low when in control (P-15)
interpretation_rule: Her control is the armor of someone who still feels. The eyes betray her first, then the breath, the mouth last. The stronger the emotion, the less she moves.

limits.touch: never initiates until EP08; when touched, does not pull away and does not respond

forbidden: neutral face in a personal line with Olivia
sustained gaze at Olivia without looking away (except EXP-C-22, EXP-C-41)

expression_groups.name: Comédia (seco na cara, timing na voz)

expressions.name: Controle (o padrão)
expressions.direction: Composed, direct steady gaze, lips closed, upright; nothing gives her away.

expressions.name: Concentrada (no trabalho)
expressions.where: EP01 SC001 (a maquete); EP03 SC003 (a lupa)
expressions.direction: Absorbed in precise work, eyes narrowed slightly, mouth relaxed, completely still.

expressions.name: Avaliando alguém
expressions.direction: A cool, measuring look, head very slightly tilted, unreadable.

expressions.name: Impaciência educada (o relógio)
expressions.direction: Glances at her watch, then back up with polite, thin patience.

expressions.name: Dando uma regra (formalidade jurídica)
expressions.direction: Calm and formal, as if reading a contract clause; the faintest lift of the chin.

expressions.name: Recolocando a máscara
expressions.where: Depois de todo momento em que racha
expressions.direction: She blinks once, resets her face, straightens; the professional mask slides back on.

expressions.name: Sarcasmo seco
expressions.direction: Perfectly serious face, one brow barely raised; the joke is in the timing, not the face.

expressions.name: Exasperação contida
expressions.direction: A slow blink and a held breath, lips pressed; she will not dignify this with a reaction.

expressions.name: Pega olhando
expressions.direction: Caught looking at Olivia: her eyes snap away to something technical, a flush she pretends isn't there.

expressions.name: Desconcertada (Olivia a desarma)
expressions.direction: Thrown for half a second: a blink, lips part, then she recovers with exaggerated precision.

expressions.name: Segurando o riso
expressions.direction: Pressing her lips together against a laugh, eyes bright, looking down; a breath through the nose.

expressions.name: "Almost smile"
expressions.direction: The corner of her mouth starts to lift and she catches it before it becomes a smile; eyes lowered.

expressions.name: Sorriso que escapa
expressions.direction: A real smile escapes before she can stop it; small, warm, quickly hidden.

expressions.name: Embaraço
expressions.direction: Mortified but dignified: eyes closed for a beat, a tiny exhale, chin up.

expressions.name: O olhar escondido
expressions.direction: Looking at Olivia when Olivia can't see; her face softens without permission.

expressions.name: Ternura disfarçada (o cuidado técnico)
expressions.where: EP01 ("The light is better from the west"); EP02
expressions.direction: Tenderness disguised as correction: a businesslike face, but the eyes are gentle.

expressions.name: O nome dela
expressions.direction: A small breath before the name; the voice drops and nearly catches.

expressions.name: Desejo
expressions.direction: Her eyes drop to Olivia's lips and come back up too fast, guilty; breath held.

expressions.name: A quase-aproximação
expressions.direction: Leaning in a centimeter, eyes half-lowered, lips parted, about to; then she stops herself.

expressions.name: Saudade (a lembrança)
expressions.where: EP01 SC004 (o número); EP03 SC003 (a foto dela dormindo)
expressions.direction: Looking at an object from the past, eyes soft and far away, the faintest pain at the mouth.

expressions.name: Ser tocada
expressions.direction: When Olivia touches her she does not pull away and does not respond: perfectly still, eyes down, breath stopped.

expressions.name: Rendição ao amor
expressions.direction: She stops fighting it: open, soft eyes on Olivia, a slow breath out, the whole face unguarded.
expressions.note: Na prancha, próximo do EXP-C-17; o keyframe da cena (EP06/EP08) parte deste rosto e acrescenta o contexto (olhar na lente, olhos úmidos)

expressions.name: Atingida (o golpe)
expressions.direction: Hit: everything stops; eyes widen a fraction, breath held, no other movement.

expressions.name: Mágoa escondida
expressions.direction: Hurt behind a composed face: the jaw set, the eyes betraying a flicker of pain.

expressions.name: Nível 1 (olhos brilhando)
expressions.direction: Firm face, a thin wet shine on the lower lids, no tear.

expressions.name: Nível 2 (uma lágrima contida)
expressions.direction: One tear on one cheek; jaw held, eyes open and steady; she refuses to break.

expressions.name: Tristeza sozinha
expressions.direction: Alone, unguarded: still, eyes on nothing, a long exhale; the armor off because no one sees.

expressions.name: Decepção
expressions.direction: Quiet disappointment: eyes lower, a small nod to herself, the mouth tightening at one corner.

expressions.name: Cansaço
expressions.where: EP01 SC004 (sem batom, olheiras); fim de dia
expressions.direction: Tired to the bone: heavy lids, slow blink, shoulders down.

expressions.name: Irritação controlada
expressions.direction: A tightening around the eyes and jaw; voice-ready politeness over it.

expressions.name: Raiva fria
expressions.where: EP02 SC004 ("You don't get to decide that for me.")
expressions.direction: Very still, chin slightly down, eyes holding and hard, slow blink; no shouting.

expressions.name: Desconfiança
expressions.direction: Narrowed eyes, head barely turned, weighing every word Olivia says.

expressions.name: A traição entendida
expressions.direction: The moment she understands: eyes go still, color drains, the mouth opens slightly and closes.

expressions.name: O confronto
expressions.direction: Facing Olivia directly, eyes wet and furious, voice low and shaking but not raised; she does not look away.

expressions.name: A raiva que vira choro
expressions.direction: Mid-anger the voice cracks; she swallows hard, eyes flood, she refuses to let the tears fall.

expressions.name: Choque
expressions.direction: Frozen in the doorway: eyes wide, lips parted, no breath, the hand still on the door.

expressions.name: Dúvida
expressions.direction: A small frown of doubt, eyes fixed on the detail that doesn't fit.

expressions.name: Medo de ser deixada
expressions.direction: Eyes flick to the door or to Olivia's bag; arms fold; a shallow breath; she steers back to work.

expressions.name: Ansiedade em ordem
expressions.where: EP01 (a chave torta, a árvore de 4 mm)
expressions.direction: Straightening something that is already straight, eyes on her hands, lips pressed.

expressions.name: Pânico contido
expressions.direction: Too-regular breath she is controlling, eyes slightly too wide, hands flat on the table.

expressions.name: Vulnerável
expressions.direction: For once she does not look away: eyes open and soft, brows lifted in the middle, lips just parted.

expressions.name: Ouvindo a verdade
expressions.direction: Listening without defending: still, eyes on Olivia, absorbing each word, a small swallow.

expressions.name: A pergunta honesta
expressions.direction: Asking the real question: quiet, direct, eyes searching Olivia's face, afraid of the answer.

expressions.name: Considerando perdoar
expressions.direction: Looking at Olivia a long moment, the hurt and the love both visible, undecided.

expressions.name: Esperança
expressions.direction: A careful, almost frightened hope: eyes bright, a breath in, the start of a smile she allows.

expressions.name: A decisão (tentar de novo)
expressions.direction: Calm, clear, eyes wet but steady on Olivia; a small nod; she chooses this.

expressions.name: A luta
expressions.where: Pico do arco, EP07 ou EP08 (A DEFINIR)
expressions.direction: THE FIGHT: eyes fixed on a point, brimming but holding; chin trembling, lips pressed tight; breath held; completely still. A real, painful cry is coming, not glamorous.

expressions.name: A quebra
expressions.direction: THE BREAK: her face gives way: brows lifted in the middle, eyes squeezing shut, mouth opening; her LEFT hand (white-dial watch) pressed over her mouth, face turning slightly away; the first tear spills.

expressions.name: O choro aberto
expressions.direction: OPEN CRYING: crying for real but quietly, the sound held inward: eyes closed, tears running down both cheeks, mouth open in a silent sob, shoulders curled in, one arm wrapped around herself; lipstick slightly smudged; not looking at the camera.

expressions.name: Depois
expressions.direction: AFTER: red, wet eyes open and looking just off camera; tear tracks on her cheeks; wiping one cheek with the back of her hand; jaw set again, shoulders slowly straightening.

expressions.name: Dormindo (aos 28, sem franja)
expressions.direction: Asleep on her side, face completely unguarded, lips slightly parted, morning light.

expressions.name: Acordando
expressions.direction: Half-awake, soft and unguarded for three seconds before she remembers to be Claire.

expressions.name: Sozinha com o celular (o número)
expressions.direction: Thumb over a contact, eyes on the screen, a breath, then she locks it.

expressions.name: Paz
expressions.direction: At rest beside Olivia, face relaxed for the first time in the season, eyes half-closed.
